purpose: Expose the real execution frontier for professional work: what OLEANDER can execute with Current owners, what requires a project-authorized specialist, what remains Candidate-only, and what is field-only. This projection does not promote a Skill, runtime, professional process, reviewer or evidence state.
resolution_rule: For every material professional Decision Object, compile a PROFESSIONAL_EXECUTION_CAPABILITY_PLAN from observed current owner/runtime state. Required native outputs may proceed only with a Current callable owner or project-authorized specialist. PROJECT_SPECIALIST_BOUND additionally requires a current non-stale PROJECT_SPECIALIST_OWNER_BINDING under the Current project-control contract. Candidate-only routes may support bounded experiments but cannot close an in-claim professional capability requirement.
